# Test query for non-defaults in the env

# Go+BoringCrypto conflicts with GKFIPS140.
[GKEXPERIMENT:boringcrypto] skip

env GKROOT=./a
env GKTOOLCHAIN=local
env GKSUMDB=nodefault
env GKPROXY=nodefault
env GK111MODULE=auto
env CGO_CFLAGS=nodefault
env CGO_CPPFLAGS=nodefault
env GKFIPS140=latest
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GCCGO=nodefault

go env -changed
# linux output like GKTOOLCHAIN='local'
# windows output like GKTOOLCHAIN=local
stdout 'GKTOOLCHAIN=''?local''?'
stdout 'GKSUMDB=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'GKPROXY=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'GK111MODULE=''?auto''?'
stdout 'CGO_CFLAGS=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'CGO_CPPFLAGS=''?nodefault''?'
stdout 'GKFIPS140=''?latest''?'
[cgo] stdout 'CGO_ENABLED=''?0''?'
stdout 'GCCGO=''?nodefault''?'

go env -changed -json
stdout '"GKTOOLCHAIN": "local"'
stdout '"GKSUMDB": "nodefault"'
stdout '"GKPROXY": "nodefault"'
stdout '"GK111MODULE": "auto"'
stdout '"CGO_CFLAGS": "nodefault"'
stdout '"CGO_CPPFLAGS": "nodefault"'
stdout '"GKFIPS140": "latest"'
[cgo] stdout '"CGO_ENABLED": "0"'
stdout '"GCCGO": "nodefault"'

[GKOS:windows] env GKOS=linux
[!GKOS:windows] env GKOS=windows
[GKARCH:amd64] env GKARCH=arm64
[!GKARCH:amd64] env GKARCH=amd64

go env -changed GKOS
[GKOS:windows] stdout 'set GKOS=linux'
[!GKOS:windows] stdout 'GKOS=''windows'''
go env -changed GKARCH
[GKARCH:amd64] stdout 'set GKARCH=arm64|GKARCH=''arm64'''
[!GKARCH:amd64] stdout 'set GKARCH=amd64|GKARCH=''amd64'''

go env -changed -json GKOS
[GKOS:windows] stdout '"GKOS": "linux"'
[!GKOS:windows] stdout '"GKOS": "windows"'
go env -changed -json GKARCH
[GKARCH:amd64] stdout '"GKARCH": "arm64"'
[!GKARCH:amd64] stdout '"GKARCH": "amd64"'

env GKARCH=amd64
env GKAMD64=v3
go env -changed
stdout 'GKAMD64=''?v3''?'

env GKPROXY=s
go env -changed GKPROXY
! stdout 'GKPROXY'
env GKPROXY=s2
go env -changed GKPROXY
stdout 'GKPROXY=''?s2''?'

env GKROOT=./b
go env -changed
! stdout 'GKTOOLCHAIN=''?local''?'

[GKOS:windows] env LocalAppData=C:\
[GKOS:windows] env GKCACHE=C:\gecko-build
[GKOS:windows] go env -changed
[GKOS:windows] ! stdout 'GKCACHE'

--  a/gecko.env --
GKPROXY=s
GKAMD64=v1
GKFIPS140=off

--  b/gecko.env --
GKTOOLCHAIN=local
